title: The first violin: A novel
author: Jessie Fothergill

authorInfo.bio: Jessie Fothergill (1851–1891) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The First Violin" by Jessie Fothergill is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story begins with a young woman named May Wedderburn, who grapples with personal challenges and a sense of loneliness despite being surrounded by family.
